description: This file defines the PersonMergeLog class, an entity in the OpenMRS system representing a log of a merge operation between two Person objects, including metadata such as the winner, loser, serialized merge details, and the user who performed the merge.

classes.name: PersonMergeLog
classes.description: Entity class representing a log entry for merging two Person instances in the OpenMRS system, including references to the winner and loser persons, serialized merge data, and audit information.

methods.name: getPersonMergeLogId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the person merge log entry.

methods.name: setPersonMergeLogId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this person merge log entry.

methods.name: getWinner
methods.description: Returns the Person object representing the winning (preferred) person in the merge.

methods.name: setWinner
methods.description: Sets the Person object representing the winner in the merge.

methods.name: getLoser
methods.description: Returns the Person object representing the losing (non-preferred) person in the merge.

methods.name: setLoser
methods.description: Sets the Person object representing the loser in the merge.

methods.name: getSerializedMergedData
methods.description: Returns the serialized XML data representing details of the merge.

methods.name: setSerializedMergedData
methods.description: Stores the serialized XML data representing the merge details.

methods.name: getPersonMergeLogData
methods.description: Returns the deserialized object representation of merge data.

methods.name: setPersonMergeLogData
methods.description: Sets the deserialized merge data object.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Overrides the setId method to assign the entity's unique identifier.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Overrides the getId method to retrieve the entity's unique identifier.
